# 4-Day Kyoto Family Trip Plan

Relaxed, family-friendly pacing for 2 adults + 1 child, designed to stay under **$2,800** excluding international flights. I’ve kept each day moderate, grouped sights by area, and limited walking where possible.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary

### Day 1: Higashiyama Temple Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and start with **Kiyomizu-dera** early to avoid crowds.
- Afternoon: Stroll the preserved lanes of **Sannenzaka / Ninenzaka**, then visit **Yasaka Shrine** and nearby **Maruyama Park**.
- Dinner: Simple Kyoto set meal near Gion; keep the evening low-key and close to the hotel.
- Walking target: **8,000–11,000 steps**
- Local transport: **¥1,200–¥2,000**
- Meal budget: **¥12,000–¥16,000**

### Day 2: Kyoto Food Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Start at **Nishiki Market** for a light breakfast and tasting stops.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning: Start at **Nishiki Market** for a light breakfast and tasting stops, Kyoto, Japan
- Afternoon: Join a **family-friendly cooking class** or tea experience in central Kyoto.
- Dinner: Kaiseki-lite or izakaya-style dinner with child-friendly dishes near downtown.
- Walking target: **6,000–9,000 steps**
- Local transport: **¥1,000–¥1,800**
- Meal budget: **¥15,000–¥22,000**

### Day 3: Kid-Friendly Kyoto Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/compass.svg
- Morning: Visit **Kyoto Railway Museum** or **Kyoto Aquarium**; both work well for a child and reduce walking.
- Afternoon: Head to **Arashiyama** for the bamboo grove area, then take a short riverfront break.
- Dinner: Easy dinner near Arashiyama or back near your hotel, depending on energy.
- Walking target: **7,000–10,000 steps**
- Local transport: **¥1,500–¥2,500**
- Meal budget: **¥12,000–¥18,000**

### Day 4: Flexible Shopping Half-Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Morning: Keep this open for **Teramachi / Shinkyogoku** shopping streets or **Kyoto Station** malls.
- Afternoon: Leave open for packing, café time, or one last short stop such as **Nijo Castle** if energy allows.
- Dinner: Final relaxed meal near the hotel or station before departure.
- Walking target: **5,000–8,000 steps**
- Local transport: **¥800–¥1,500**
- Meal budget: **¥10,000–¥16,000**

## Budget Plan and Local Transit Costs

| Category | Estimated Total | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotel | **¥140,000–¥220,000** | 3–4 nights in a family room or 2-room setup |
| Local transport | **¥4,500–¥7,800** | Buses, subway, occasional taxi |
| Meals | **¥49,000–¥72,000** | Mix of casual lunches and nicer dinners |
| Activities / admissions | **¥18,000–¥40,000** | Temples, museum, aquarium, cooking class |
| Shopping buffer | **¥20,000–¥50,000** | Flexible, optional |
| Total estimated trip cost | **¥231,500–¥389,800** | Well within your $2,800 cap in most scenarios |

## Rainy-Day Backup Plan

### Indoor-Friendly Swap
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-rain.svg
- Replace the temple-heavy outdoor day with **Kyoto National Museum**, **Kyoto Aquarium**, or **Kyoto Railway Museum**.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/61/Flowers_and_Birds_byobu_Sesshu_attrib_%28Kyoto_National_Museum%29.jpg Alt=Replace the temple-heavy outdoor day with **Kyoto National Museum**, **Kyoto Aquarium**, or **Kyoto Railway Museum**, Kyoto, Japan
- Move market time to **Nishiki Market** and add a long lunch break.
- Keep one short taxi ride in reserve to reduce wet-weather walking.
- Good low-walk combo: **museum + café + department store browsing + early dinner**.

### Best Rainy Day Fit
- **Most flexible day to swap:** Day 4 shopping half-day
- **Best indoor family day:** Day 3 if weather is poor
- **Best low-walk temple alternative:** **Nijo Castle** or a shorter shrine visit plus indoor lunch
